description.value: Pawan's Indian Kitchen is an Indian restaurant on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver serving dine-in, takeout, and delivery. Customer reviews highlight generous portions and bold flavours, making it a filling stop for cyclists passing through the Lonsdale corridor. Takeout and delivery options add flexibility for riders who prefer to eat on the go.
